portion_doctrine: PIXIESET HELP DOCUMENTATION - OPERATIONAL REFERENCE (Segments 11-17 of 17). This is Pixieset's official help center documentation covering pricing, fulfillment, shipping, taxes, billing, client gallery, studio manager, booking, and account management. Segments 11-17 contain: pricing structure and markup mechanics, product categories, shipping methods, automated and manual tax setup, mobile gallery apps, studio manager bookings, contact management, document workflows, project management, branding, subscription tiers (Free, Upgraded, Suite), billing charges, and account security settings. Core gold: documented operational system endpoints, pricing/tax formulas, shipping/fulfillment workflows, contact and document automation rules, and subscription architecture. Predominantly help center UI documentation with setup steps and FAQ. No strategic doctrine, no brand positioning, no customer psychology, no unique operational secret.
operating_rules: Markup maintenance: Pixieset auto-updates prices to maintain your set markup percentage when lab costs change, rounded up to nearest dollar (can disable/adjust rounding in Store > Settings).

Lab Color Correction: Additional $1.20/item when enabled on WHCC/ProDPI/Automatic lab (not available for cards/albums/books); Miller's/Loxley Colour offer free color correction; Mpix/Atkins Pro do not offer.
Digital download watermarks: Watermarks DO NOT appear on high-res downloads (original or 3600px); watermarks can be optionally applied only to web-size downloads (640px, 1024px, 2048px).

Order Delay enables: review client album/book designs before order finalization; adjust crops, change spreads, replace photos, update debossing text, edit shipping address. Cost changes = must cancel and reorder.
Contact automation: Brand new inquiry = auto-created as Lead; brand new booking = auto-created as Client; Lead/Other converting to Client when they book or pay invoice.

Shipping country availability: Automatic fulfillment shipping = dependent on selected print lab (WHCC: USA/Canada/International; Atkins Pro: AU/NZ/International; Loxley Colour: extensive EU coverage). Self-fulfillment requires explicit shipping method per country.
Tax automation: US stores only - TaxJar partnership auto-calculates state/county/district taxes based on business address + client shipping address. Manual tax setup required outside US.
Session intake: minimum fields = first name, last name, email. Optional: phone, address. Upgraded plans allow required questionnaire + contract as booking prerequisite.
Payment methods accepted: Pixieset Payments (bank transfer US only), Stripe (card/debit), PayPal Express Checkout, PayPal card/debit, Manual Payment (cash/check/offline).
Mobile Gallery App image cap: up to 200 images per app. Free plan: 3 apps max. Paid/Suite plans: unlimited apps.
CSV import platforms supported: Bloom.io, Dubsado, Honeybook, Session, Shootproof, Studio Ninja, 17Hats. Duplicate emails skipped on import.

Email template file attachments: max 25MB per message; supported formats: docs (doc/docx/pdf/ppt/pptx/rtf/key/numbers/pages/xls/xlsx/csv/txt/html/xml), media (bmp/gif/jpeg/jpg/png/svg/tiff/psd/avi/mkv/mp4/mov/wmv/aac/mp3/ogg/wav), other (ics/zip/rar/tar).
gates: Album/book customization gate: Product personalization done entirely in client-facing designer tool; photographer cannot directly edit client-created designs (preview only); if changes cost more, must cancel/reorder.
Self-fulfillment mixed with automatic: self-fulfillment items in auto-fulfillment price sheets do not show self-fulfillment shipping methods; use Extra Shipping per-item instead.
Card designer availability gate: Card designer available ONLY for automatic fulfillment price sheets; Australia/New Zealand use limited Atkins Pro single-photo card designs (no designer).
Payment decline coping: Monthly subscriptions maintain original billing date even after decline retry; yearly unchanged.
tools: TaxJar integration (US stores only) for automated sales tax calculation
Pixieset CSV import (supports 7 third-party platforms + native template)
Google Calendar sync for Studio Manager sessions
Zoom/Google Meet integration for booking workflows
Mobile Gallery App designer (up to 200 images, custom cover/theme/layout/icon)
Studio Manager project board (drag-drop stages, customizable workflow)
Contact form builder with 8+ field types and conditional logic
Email template system with rich formatting and file attachment support
content_ideas: Markup maintenance as competitive moat: positioning how auto-margin preservation differentiates Pixieset from manual pricing management elsewhere.
Lab color correction: case study on why professional color grading at lab (per-item, calibration-agnostic) is worth $1.20.

Watermark split-register doctrine for prints: high-res deliverables are unwatermarked (client-facing); web/social downloads can be watermarked. Framing: authenticity for print, protection for digital.
Order Delay as revision control: positioned as 'design approval before fulfillment' not just 'fix mistakes after booking.'
Mobile Gallery App as sneak-peek distribution layer: 200-image cap positions it as 'curated highlight reel' not 'full archive delivery.'
